subject: (devel version of shiny) removal of sendJavascript

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: (devel version of shiny) removal of sendJavascript
parts:
This is only relevant for people who are using the development version of Shiny, and are using the sendJavascript function from it.

I don't know if anyone has actually made use of the sendJavascript function, but if you are using it, you should know that it's been removed, because it does something that's hacky: it allows you to send Javascript code from the server, to be evaluated on the client.

If you need this functionality, you can easily add a custom message handler which has the same effect, using only a few lines of code. There's a minimal example app at:
https://github.com/wch/testapp/tree/master/sendjs

-Winston
